title: Compatible local constant stalk tower before effectivity
statement: Let X be Noetherian, g:Y to X an immersion, d an adic coefficient datum on A with ideal I, and M a normalized adic tower over X. Assume for each n that the cohomology sheaves of M_n vanish outside some integer interval depending on n, and for every n and degree q that the cohomology of the exact inverse image of M_n along g, after restriction along the fixed constant-to-finite coefficient isomorphism, is relatively finite lisse over the inverse image of the constant ring A/I^(n+1). Put C=AdicCompletion(I,A) and J=IC. There is a covering sieve on the final pro-etale object of Y. On each member U there is a tower K_n in D(C/J^(n+1)), with universal consecutive arrows t_n, finite cohomology, and transfer of every vanishing cohomology of M_n. Its concrete finite constant realizations F_n(K_n) are isomorphic by b_n to the actual restricted M_n. The latter have relatively finite-lisse cohomology. Write s for the strict C-linear tower obtained from t by the fixed restriction composition maps, and z_n for the canonical right comparison of lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison followed by restriction of b_n. For every n<=m, z_m followed by restriction of the actual M transition and the restriction composition isomorphism equals a_g(s_mn) followed by z_n. There is no effective E, no scalar left adjoint supplied and no comparison of finite reductions of such an E.

proof.text: Apply lisse_tower_stalk_level_models. This supplies a covering sieve V and, on each member U, K,t with universal arrows, finite cohomology, all vanishing transfers, finite lissity on all refinements and separate level markings.

Use each original level interval and its vanishing-transfer implication to bound K at that level. Apply lisse_tower_compatible_stalk_markings to the supplied K,t, their universality, the induced bounds, finite cohomology, and the separate markings. Obtain a covering sieve T_U on U with compatible b on every member.

Bind V with the sieves T_U. Mathlib GrothendieckTopology.bind_covering makes the bound sieve covering. Membership gives a factorization W to U to the final object; retain K,t and the vanishing and finiteness witnesses of U, the finite lissity on W, and b with its exact all-pairs equation from T_U. This proves the original unchanged conclusion.

theorem lisse_tower_constant_stalk_models
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hlisse : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) :
    let C := AdicCompletion d.ideal A
    let J := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A C)
    ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ Y.ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology Y (⊤_ Y.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : Y.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ Y.ProEt), V f →
        ∃ (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))))
          (t : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
              (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                  (K n)),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1)))),
            Function.Bijective (fun k : K n ⟶ N ↦ t n ≫
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.map
                    k)) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)) →
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n))) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Module.Finite (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n))) ∧
          let R (n : ℕ) := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))
          let s (n : ℕ) := (R (n + 1)).mapDerivedCategory.map (t n) ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))))
              (R (n + 1))).inv.app (K n) ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'.{u + 1}
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 2)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.factor_comp_mk _).symm)).inv.app (K n)
          ∃ b : ∀ n : ℕ,
              (constantAdicQuotientRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (K n) ≅
                (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj
                  (M.level n),
            (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
              IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (U.hom ≫ g) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
                ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map
                  (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
                    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                      ((adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g)
                        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) ∧
            let a := constantAdicFiniteRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d
            let H (n : ℕ) := pbcDerivedRestrict (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d n)
            let z (n : ℕ) :=
              (constantAdicQuotientRightIso (U.hom ≫ g) d n).hom.app (K n) ≫
                (H n).map (b n).hom
            ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
              z m ≫ (H m).map (adicTowerRestrictedTransition d (U.hom ≫ g) M m n h) ≫
                (pbcDerivedRestrictComp
                  (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d m)
                  ((adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n h))
                  (constantAdicFiniteProjection (U.hom ≫ g) d n)
                  (constantAdicFiniteProjection_comp (U.hom ≫ g) d m n h)).hom.app
                    ((adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g)
                      ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n)) =
                a.map ((Functor.ofOpSequence
                  (X := fun k : ℕ ↦ (R k).mapDerivedCategory.obj (K k)) s).map
                    (homOfLE h).op) ≫ z n
